newsitem.title: INDIA: India CESC to raise $70 mln through FRN.
newsitem.headline: India CESC to raise $70 mln through FRN.

text.p: Indian power utility firm CESC Ltd will begin roadshows on April 16 for a $70 million floating rate note (FRN) issue, lead manager ANZ Investment Bank said on Thursday.
The coupon on the notes will be U.S.$ Libor plus 135-150 basis points per annum, ANZ Investment Bank, part of the ANZ Banking Group, said in a statement.
The statement said roadshows begin April 16 in Tokyo.
The FRNs, due May 2007, have a put/call option at the end of seven years (2004), it added.
ANZ said the settlement was Euroclear/Cedel and the notes were unsecured, unsubordinated obligations of the issuer.
The issue will be in the form of registered global notes in denominations of $10,000/100,000 and listed at Luxembourg, it said. Governing law would be English.
